summary: Completed testing of bug fixes and new features for Iteration 7. All reported bugs have been fixed: 1) User list on /admin/users now shows 12 users with all data (name, sector, grade, level), 2) Presence status correctly shows ONLINE after login, 3) Logo is visible on Login page, TopBar, and Sidebar, 4) Back button on login page works and navigates to /city, 5) Duplicate email/badge errors return specific messages.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login - Returns correct user data (sector=ADMIN, grade=Super Admin, hierarchy_level=10)
GET /api/chat/presence/me - Returns current user's presence status
GET /api/users/all/list - Returns 12 users with all required fields
GET /api/users/all/list - Contains admin user with correct data
GET /api/users/all/list - Contains LSPD users with non-empty grades
POST /api/users/create with duplicate email - Returns 409 with 'Email già registrata nel sistema'
POST /api/users/create with duplicate badge - Returns 409 with 'Matricola già in uso da un altro utente'
UI: Logo visible on Login page (above title)
UI: Back button '← TORNA INDIETRO' visible on Login page
UI: Back button navigates to /city when clicked
UI: Login with admin@purelife.rp / Admin@2026! redirects to /admin
UI: Presence status shows 'ONLINE' with green indicator after login
UI: Logo visible in TopBar (after INDIETRO/HOME buttons)
UI: Logo visible in Sidebar/Layout header
UI: /admin/users page loads and shows 12 users
UI: User table shows all columns (Utente, Settore, Grado, Livello, Capo, Stato, Ultimo Accesso, Azioni)

Presence state correctly saved in AuthContext and displayed in Layout/TopBar
Logo properly loaded from /logo.png in Login, TopBar, and Sidebar components
Back button on LoginPage correctly navigates to /city
